entities.name: Félicie d'Ayzac
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félicie-Marie-Emilie d'Ayzac (1801–1881) was a French poet and art historian. She is remembered for her poetry collection Soupirs poétiques (1833), and for her Histoire de l'abbaye de Saint-Denis.
